description: Pipeline input — selected graph(s) by id (Select → Graph scope, or grab from selection). Outputs one handle per graph. Feeds Mitered Join / Graph Smoothing / Graph Metrics.
instructions:
Pipeline input — emits one or more graphs (connected segment networks) as polylines. References graphs by display id (e.g. Graph001, comma-separated for several); with 'Grab ID from selection' on, the id stays synced to the graph selected via the Select tool (Graph scope). One output handle per graph, or a single bundle (`outputMode`).

The input endpoint accepts a Schema node to attach Node/Segment/Graph schema properties (geometry still comes from the canvas). Feeds Mitered Join / Graph Smoothing / Graph Metrics / Graph to Spaces.
